About

Automation plus support experience.

Civil Engineering graduate with experience in technical coordination and construction support, now focused on helping businesses generate leads and improve workflow efficiency through automation. I build lead scraping tools to collect targeted business data and organize leads for outreach and sales.

I also create beginner-level automation workflows using n8n, APIs, and CRM tools to reduce manual work in data collection, lead tracking, and customer interaction. With a strong background in customer service, I handle communication across phone, email, chat, and social media while keeping client satisfaction front and center.
